user.title: Esteo (Chery RU)
user.description: Connect to your Chery vehicle via the Esteo telematics.

oauth.title: Esteo account
oauth.description:
1. Open the authorization URL below in a browser and log in with your Esteo account.
2. After login the browser will land on `{redirect_uri}` (the page may not load — that is OK).
3. Copy the FULL address from the browser address bar (it must contain `code=`) and paste it below.

Authorization URL: {authorize_url}

data.redirect_url: Paste the final browser URL here

select_vehicle.title: Select vehicle
select_vehicle.description: Choose the vehicle to add to Home Assistant.

direct.title: Direct TSP token (advanced)
direct.description: Enter the Chery TSP userToken (obtained e.g. via a traffic capture or from integration logs) and the VIN.

error.oauth_failed: Authorization failed — check that you pasted the full URL with the code
error.state_mismatch: This redirect belongs to a different login attempt — restart the setup and use the fresh URL
error.tsp_validation_failed: The TSP rejected the token/VIN — check the values
error.tsp_empty_state: The vehicle returned an empty state — is the token valid?

abort.no_vehicles: No vehicles found in your Esteo garage
abort.tsp_login_failed: Could not obtain Chery TSP credentials for this account
